title: Transport of adjunction mates through adjoint isomorphisms
statement: Let A,B,C,D be categories, G:A→C and H:B→D functors, and L⊣R, L′⊣R′, K⊣S, K′⊣S′ adjunctions between the indicated categories. For isomorphisms p:L≅L′ and q:K≅K′, let t:G⋙K→L⋙H and t′:G⋙K′→L′⋙H be natural transformations satisfying q.inv at G(M), followed by t at M, equals t′ at M followed by H(p.inv at M). Then for every object N of B, mate(t) at N followed by conjugate(q.inv) at H(N) equals G(conjugate(p.inv) at N) followed by mate(t′) at N. The conjugates use the respective pairs of adjunctions.

source.place: Coefficient comparisons preserve evaluation and adjunction units/counits; primitive whole-system operation comparison in Step 1 of lem-sf-integral-support-strict-tower-comparison. Stacks 03DI, 0941, 0D6E; Zheng Construction 4.1 and Lemma 4.10.

proof.text: Apply the inverse hom-set equivalence for K′⊣S′ to the two proposed maps. Its injectivity reduces the conclusion to equality after applying K′ and postcomposing with the counit of K′⊣S′. Expand this inverse equivalence by its counit formula.

On the left, use the conjugate counit equation for q.inv. Move q.inv across the map given by the first mate using naturality. The counit characterization of that mate then gives q.inv at G(R(N)), followed by t at R(N), followed by H of the counit for L⊣R. Apply the assumed square equation to its first two factors and combine the two H images.

On the right, apply the counit characterization of the second mate. Naturality of t′ moves G of the conjugate of p.inv to its right side. Combine the two H images and use the conjugate counit equation for p.inv. Both sides are now t′ at R(N), followed by the H-image of the composite of p.inv at R(N) and the counit for L⊣R. Associativity gives equality; injectivity from the first step gives the desired mate identity.

theorem transport_mates
    {A B C D : Type*} [Category A] [Category B] [Category C] [Category D]
    {L L' : A ⥤ B} {R R' : B ⥤ A} {K K' : C ⥤ D} {S S' : D ⥤ C}
    {G : A ⥤ C} {H : B ⥤ D}
    (a : L ⊣ R) (a' : L' ⊣ R') (b : K ⊣ S) (b' : K' ⊣ S')
    (p : L ≅ L') (q : K ≅ K')
    (t : TwoSquare G L K H) (t' : TwoSquare G L' K' H)
    (ht : ∀ M, q.inv.app (G.obj M) ≫ t.app M = t'.app M ≫ H.map (p.inv.app M))
    (M : B) :
    (mateEquiv a b t).natTrans.app M ≫ (conjugateEquiv b b' q.inv).app (H.obj M) =
      G.map ((conjugateEquiv a a' p.inv).app M) ≫ (mateEquiv a' b' t').natTrans.app M
